newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold's Schuitema sees EPS 1997 equal to 1996.
newsitem.headline: Ahold's Schuitema sees EPS 1997 equal to 1996.

text.p: Schuitema NV, 73 percent owned by Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV, said on Wednesday it expected 1997 profits per share to equal those of 1996.
Earnings per share rose to 188.85 guilders in 1996 from 181.65 guilders in 1995.
"We expect, barring unforseen circumstances, to post a profit per share in the current financial year which will be at least equal (to 1996)," Schuitema said in a statement.
It said it would raise the 1996 dividend to 75.00 guilders per share from 1995's 72.50.
Total 1996 net profit went up to 45.3 million guilders, compared with 43.6 million in the previous year. Turnover grew to 3.185 billion guilders from 3.062 billion in 1995.
